gaps.lead: The party was incredibly boring, so we left early.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ we left early.

gaps.lead: There isn't a single clean cup left in the cupboard.
gaps.hint: run out of = have none left
gaps.explanation: run out of = have no more of something left.

gaps.lead: She found it hard to understand the accent.
gaps.explanation: 'Have difficulty (in) doing' = find it hard to do.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: Phoebe was surprised to be offered a place on the course.
gaps.sentence: The offer of a place on the course ___ Phoebe.
gaps.hint: surprised by = come as a surprise to
gaps.explanation: 'Was surprised' becomes 'came as a surprise to her'.

gaps.lead: The concert was cancelled because hardly anybody came.
gaps.sentence: The concert was cancelled ___ people came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.
